{{Short description|Configuration space}}
{{Sources exist|date=February 2023}}
In geometry, the '''Fulton–MacPherson [[compactification (mathematics)|compactification]]''' of the [[configuration space (mathematics)|configuration space]] of ''n'' distinct labeled points in a compact complex manifold is a compact complex manifold that contains the configuration space as an open dense subset and is constructed in a canonical way.<ref>Voronov</ref> The notion was introduced by {{harvtxt|Fulton|MacPherson|1994}}.
